title: Wave E intervention-selection leg — Northern cod (Omega_2016): robust kernels of the LRP safe set under persistent productivity-shock floors
object: governed surplus-production object (the ladder's M2 class, Allee off); NOT NCAM; no Omega_xte row

safe_set.declared: the 2016 LRP (1983-1989 mean SSB), the single [N] threshold of Omega_2016

erosion.form: expansive form: a_max = sup F' on [K*, S_HI] = 1.1531 > 1 at the safe-set boundary (F'(S) decreasing in S; F'(S_HI) = 0.2894); the contraction form of the Cor2/Cor5 conversion is INAPPLICABLE; r_T = eps(a_max^T - 1)/(a_max - 1)
erosion.formula: r_T = eps(1-a^T)/(1-a) if a < 1 (contraction); eps(a^T-1)/(a-1) otherwise (expansive); certified kernel = nominal kernel of K* + r_T
